response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT CENTROMEA AS status, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(`T-BIL` / CRE) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE Date >= '1985-04-22' AND Date <= '1994-03-14' GROUP BY CENTROMEA), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM g) SELECT g.status, g.avg_hgb, g.avg_ratio, g.avg_ratio / m.mean_ratio AS ratio_to_mean FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: The overall mean is the plain, unweighted average of the per-status average ratios. This includes the NULL-status group, and statuses whose average ratio is NULL are skipped. Each status's average ratio is the average of per-row T-BIL/CRE, with rows where either value is NULL or CRE is 0 ignored (SQLite returns NULL for division by zero).
The date filter compares the stored Date text directly with the two bounds, inclusive, as the request says.
